stem:
The random variable $X$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} \frac{k}{\sqrt{x}} & 0 < x \leqslant a, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ and $a$ are constants. It is given that $\text{E}(X) = 3$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the value of $a$ and show that $k = \frac{1}{6}$.
